source_target: Unique known physical cue whose full uncertainty/support raster contains the unchanged query central4 native bilinear footprint, with explicit unknown/partial/unlocated competition. Conditional AUX only, native expectedpart UNKNOWN.

construction.scope: Same original q/L/folds; one BEFORE plus16 COVER+SHAM pairs per base=31680 occurrences. D61 construction eligible, naturalE4 BEFORE only, all failures/unknowns U. All original C1/V95 labels retained separately.
construction.target_mask: Complete original matched certified cue group support/uncertainty raster union, plus exact central4 positive-weight native stencil; no shrinking original boxes.
construction.donors: 16 distinct deterministic minSHA assigned ranks from same TRAIN odd objects/scenes0..7 versusVAL even objects/scenes8..9. No replacement after failures or target-specific success search.
construction.alpha: V95 exclusive selectedvis minus all-other-vis union, complete BOP scene_gt instance set required.
construction.geometry: Pinned V94 V2 erode1/maxrectangle/scale<=4/whole<=.8L/fixedplacement/equal native area and RGB96 mass; all protected coveralpha1/shamalpha0.
construction.input_features: Every changed fullRGB fresh matching frozen P3ROI+RGB96 at originalq/L; exact unchanged fullRGB can bound-reuse original3tensors.

model.initialization: Fresh seed194, same scalar at train/VAL/deploy, no coordinate output; only P3ROI/RGB96/valid.

training.sampling: Replacement within each fixed cohort, CPU generator seed194 thenshuffle64. Natural realE2TRAIN oversampled as declared. No online augmentation.

selector.criterion: Equal mean of five VAL cohort BCE means: LOCO_BEFORE_D,PALLOX_BEFORE_D,BEFORE_E,SHAM_D,COVER_E; unavailable safe0/ln2 included. Strict lower, exacttie earliest.
selector.threshold: Raw scalar0: D iffz<0, hidden auxiliaryE iffz>=0, unavailableU.

missing_cohort_rule: No fit if any required TRAIN/VAL cohort empty. Controlled results per source family separately reported; family with zero controlled pairs remains untested, not a transfer success.
limits: Source counts tiny and single physical Pallox bin plus6 LOCO cue views; no generalization proof.
